homepage.heroTitle: The global gathering for young people shaping the world's climate future
homepage.heroDescription: The 21st Global Conference of Children and Youth on Climate Change (COY21), co-organised by YOUNGO, brings together young climate advocates, organizers, and delegates from around the world in Antalya, Turkiye, the week before COP30.
homepage.aboutBody: COY (Conference of Youth) is the official youth-led conference held before each UN Climate Change Conference (COP). Co-organised by YOUNGO, the official Children and Youth Constituency of the UNFCCC, COY brings together young people from across the globe to exchange ideas, build capacity, and coordinate a shared youth voice on climate action. COY21 is open to all young people under 35.
homepage.themesIntro: The conference programme is organized around three themes, with meaningful youth participation, climate justice, and global cooperation woven through all of them.
homepage.theme2Title: Just Transition, Green Economy and Climate Innovation
homepage.theme3Title: Climate Finance, Governance and Inclusive Leadership

about.title: About COY21
about.intro: COY21 Turkiye 2026 is the 21st Global Conference of Children and Youth on Climate Change, co-organised by YOUNGO, the official Children and Youth Constituency of the UNFCCC.
about.whatBody: COY (Conference of Youth) is the official youth-led conference held before each UN Climate Change Conference (COP), co-organised by YOUNGO. COY brings together young people from across the globe to exchange ideas, build capacity, coordinate a shared youth voice on climate action, and engage meaningfully in international climate policy. COY21 takes place November 5-7, 2026, in Antalya, Turkiye, the week before COP30.
about.whoBody: COY21 is open to young people under 35 from around the world, including climate advocates, youth-led organizers, delegates, students, and anyone working on climate issues in their communities who wants to connect with global peers and engage in the UNFCCC process.
about.visionBody: A world where young people are empowered to lead climate action, shape climate policy, and drive the just and sustainable transformation needed to protect people and the planet.
about.missionBody: To convene young people from across the globe through an inclusive youth-led platform that builds capacity, promotes global collaboration, and strengthens meaningful youth participation in national, regional, and international climate processes ahead of COP30.
about.whyMenaBody: Turkiye sits at the crossroads of Europe and Asia, making Antalya an accessible and strategically significant host city for a global youth conference. Turkiye is home to a vibrant and growing youth climate movement, and its geographic and environmental context, including coastal vulnerability, extreme heat, and biodiversity pressures, reflects many of the climate challenges young people around the world are confronting.
about.whyOmanBody: Antalya is one of Turkiye's most internationally connected cities, with direct flight links across Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The city's modern conference infrastructure, welcoming environment, and Mediterranean climate make it an ideal setting for COY21. Hosting COY here brings the global youth climate conversation to a region where climate impacts are already being felt, from rising sea temperatures to changing rainfall patterns.
about.themesIntro: COY21 is organized around three global themes, with cross-cutting priorities including meaningful youth participation, climate justice, gender equality, and global cooperation integrated throughout.
about.theme1Title: Theme 1: Adaptation, Resilience and Human Well-being
about.theme1Body: How communities around the world can respond to climate impacts while protecting people, livelihoods, ecosystems, and essential services, including climate adaptation, water and food security, climate and health, disaster risk reduction, biodiversity, and climate mobility.
about.theme2Title: Theme 2: Just Transition, Green Economy and Climate Innovation
about.theme2Body: Pathways towards inclusive, low-carbon, climate-resilient economies that create opportunities for young people, including energy transition, circular economy, green jobs and youth entrepreneurship, sustainable mobility, and youth-led innovation.
about.theme3Title: Theme 3: Climate Finance, Governance and Inclusive Leadership
about.theme3Body: The policies, institutions, and financial mechanisms needed to turn climate commitments into action, including climate finance, climate governance and international negotiations, youth participation and climate justice, inclusive governance, and global partnerships.
about.organizersBody: COY21 is co-organised by YOUNGO, the official Children and Youth Constituency of the UNFCCC, the global network of youth non-governmental organizations working on climate change.
about.ayscTitle: YOUNGO: Children and Youth Constituency of the UNFCCC
about.ayscBody: YOUNGO is the official constituency representing children and youth in the UNFCCC process. It is a global network of youth non-governmental organizations (NGOs) working on climate change. YOUNGO facilitates meaningful youth participation in international climate negotiations, coordinates youth positions, and organises COY before each COP to ensure that the voices of young people are heard at the highest levels of global climate governance.
about.howBody: COY21 is open to young people under 35 from around the world. Registration details and the application process will be announced through YOUNGO and COY21 official channels. This site will be updated with further detail on sessions, speakers, and partners as those are confirmed.
about.ctaLogIn: Already registered? Log in to your account.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: Answers to common questions about COY21 Turkiye 2026. If your question isn't covered here, reach out via the contact page.
faq.venueNote: COY21 will be held in Antalya, Turkiye, from November 5 to 7, 2026, the week before COP30.
faq.q1answer: COY21 is open to young people under 35 from around the world, including climate advocates, youth-led organizers, students, and anyone working on climate issues who wants to engage with the UNFCCC process and connect with global peers.
faq.q2answer: Funding information will be announced through YOUNGO and COY21 official channels. There may be limited funded spots. We encourage all interested young people to follow official channels for updates.
faq.q3question: Do I need a visa to attend?
faq.q3answer: Participants from most countries will need a visa to enter Turkiye. The COY21 organizing team will provide guidance and support letters for visa applications. Details will be shared with registered participants.
faq.q4question: Can I participate if my climate work experience is limited?
faq.q4answer: Yes. COY is designed to be inclusive. Whether you are an experienced climate negotiator or just beginning your climate journey, there are spaces and sessions for everyone.
faq.q5answer: The selection process is managed by YOUNGO and the COY21 organizing team, with clear criteria focused on youth engagement, geographic diversity, and commitment to climate action.
faq.q6question: How do I apply to participate?
faq.q6answer: Registration and application details will be announced through YOUNGO's official channels. Follow YOUNGO and COY21 on social media and check the official UNFCCC youth pages for updates.
faq.q7question: I was invited, where do I log in?
faq.q7answer: Invited participants can log in using the Log in link in the site header to access their account, application status, and, once published, their personal session schedule.
faq.q8question: How can I get in touch with the organizing team?
faq.q8answer: Use the details on the Contact page to reach the COY21 organizing team by email.
faq.why1Body: COY21 brings together over 1000 young climate leaders from more than 100 countries, alongside government representatives, UN agencies, and academic experts. You will connect directly with peers from around the world in one space, opening doors to scholarships, fellowships, training opportunities, and partnerships that can shape your path in climate action.
faq.why2Title: Help shape the Global Youth Statement ahead of COP30
faq.why2Body: Your participation places you at the heart of climate decision-making. Working alongside youth from every region, you will contribute to the Global Youth Statement that goes directly to the UN climate negotiations at COP30. Your ideas and recommendations officially reach the global negotiating table.
faq.why3Title: Gain real experience in climate negotiations and diplomacy
faq.why3Body: COY21 offers practical sessions and simulation exercises on climate negotiations. This hands-on experience puts you in decision-makers' shoes, helping you understand multilateral diplomacy, different national positions, and how to build consensus and advocate effectively for climate ambition.
faq.why4Title: A global climate conference in Antalya, Turkiye
faq.why4Body: Attending COY21 in Antalya places you at the centre of a major global climate moment, just one week before COP30. Turkiye's rich natural landscapes and climate vulnerabilities provide a living backdrop for discussions on adaptation, resilience, and the urgent need for global climate action.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: COY21 2026 is committed to making this site usable for everyone. This statement describes the accessibility work already built into the site, and will be updated as the site continues to develop.
accessibility.keyboardBody: Every interactive element on this site, including navigation links, the mobile menu, and FAQ entries, is operable from the keyboard alone, with no mouse required. Buttons use native HTML button elements, so standard Enter/Space activation works without extra code.
accessibility.focusBody: The mobile navigation menu traps keyboard focus while open, moves focus into the menu when it opens, and returns focus to the button that opened it when it closes, so keyboard users are never dropped somewhere unexpected. Focus states are visible throughout the site.
accessibility.languageBody: The site is fully available in both English and Arabic, including correct right-to-left layout, text direction, and mirrored navigation placement when Arabic is selected. This is handled at the page level, not just by flipping text.
accessibility.structureBody: Navigation regions are labeled landmarks, interactive controls carry appropriate ARIA attributes (for example aria-expanded and aria-controls on the FAQ accordion, aria-modal and aria-label on the mobile menu dialog), and status messages such as "content coming soon" notices use role="status" so assistive technology announces them.
accessibility.feedbackBody: If you encounter an accessibility barrier anywhere on this site, please let us know via the Contact page so it can be addressed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft: this page has not yet undergone legal review. It describes the intended approach and must not be treated as final or legally authoritative until confirmed.
privacy.intro: This policy explains, in general terms, what information COY21 2026 collects and how it is used. It applies to this website and to the participant application process.
privacy.collectionBody: When you apply to participate, we collect information you provide directly, such as your name, contact details, and application answers. Basic technical information (such as browser type) may also be collected automatically for security and site-operation purposes.
privacy.useBody: Information collected is used to process applications, communicate with applicants and participants, organize the conference (including scheduling and logistics), and improve this site. It is not sold to third parties.
privacy.sharingBody: Information may be shared with the COY21 organizing team and, where necessary for running the conference, with partner organizations directly involved in logistics, always limited to what is needed for that purpose.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy can be sent via the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.draftNotice: Draft: this page has not yet undergone legal review. It describes the intended approach and must not be treated as final or legally authoritative until confirmed.
terms.intro: These terms govern use of the COY21 2026 website. By using this site, you agree to use it responsibly and in accordance with these terms.
terms.useBody: This site is provided to share information about COY21 2026 and to support the participant application and conference-management process. Content is provided in good faith but may change as plans are finalized.
terms.accountsBody: Participant accounts are provided to individuals invited to participate in COY21 2026. Account access is personal and should not be shared.
terms.contentBody: We aim to keep information on this site accurate and up to date, but details such as the agenda, speakers, and partners may change before the conference and will be updated as they are confirmed.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms can be sent via the Contact page.
